cause: is-terminal0.1.1 upstream multi-release JAR has Java23 bytecode in its Java22 override; JDK22 selects that entry and throws UnsupportedClassVersionError. The formatter cache leaves later callers waiting after the fatal initializer failure.
reviewer_verification: Independent reviewer compared the local JAR with a fresh Maven Central copy and its published SHA1, then inspected both class headers.
workaround: Run unchanged formatting checks on installed JDK25; retain successful compilation/tests on JDK22. CI17 uses the valid base class. No dependency or formatter version change.
